in_marathi.name: Sahanur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who is calm and peaceful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahanur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sahana means calm and ur means body, thus Sahanur is one who is calm and peaceful in their nature
